name: ML PoS Prior
description: A structured-feature logistic-regression classifier that estimates phase-to-approval probability from the same inputs the deterministic chain uses (phase, TA, modality, capital position, regulatory designations, biomarker enrichment, target validation, competitor count). Trained on a synthetic dataset sampled from the BIO base rates with stochastic outcomes. Acts as a smoothed, continuous-valued second opinion to the rule-based PoS chain. Disagreement between the two paths surfaces as an uncertainty signal — the plan's 'disagreement-between-methods' beat. The BioBERT/CTOP path is documented as v1.5.2.
